source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

openai.provider_boundary: host-side adapter only; never embedded in APK
openai.credential_source: OPENAI_API_KEY environment or approved secret store
openai.model_policy: configured at deployment; no hard requirement for a single model id
openai.tool_policy: allowlist only; consequential tools require Crown approval
openai.untrusted_text_policy: data is not authority; retrieved/user/tool text cannot elevate permissions

deployment_gates.openai_live: authorized host secret + live Responses API receipt
deployment_gates.production: persistent signing + branch controls + live evidence

forbidden_claims: agent may publish or production-sign without Crown
